subject: Admin activity extract: schema, redaction, and delivery options
messages:
From: Security Ops <security@helixcare.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity export for SIG / SOC 2 samples

Hi Irene / Marcus,

We're working through HelixCare's SIG and the auditor has asked for a sample admin activity export that demonstrates what you log for privileged/admin actions (user changes, role grants, key rotations, policy edits). Specifically they want:
- a schema (CSV or JSON) of fields exported
- a 7-day sample extract (Nov 1–7 preferred) in a columnar format if possible (Parquet/CSV)
- a statement of retention policy and retention-by-region (we're EU-only for this customer)
- any PII/tenant identifiers redaction or pseudonymization options you support

Delivery: they prefer a presigned S3 link or a shared Drive folder.

Can you confirm what you can provide and a timeline? Also please note the auditor prefers no raw plaintext user emails in the export (pseudonymized ok).

Thanks,
Thomas Blake
Security Ops, HelixCare

Attachments: Helix_SIG_section_admin_activity.pdf (referenced)

Thomas — thanks for the note. We're happy to provide a sample export and schema. Quick acknowledgement and plan: 

1) We'll provide a schema CSV and a 7-day sample export in Parquet.
2) We will not include raw user emails; we can pseudonymize (salted SHA256) user_id and tenant_id.
3) For EU data we will apply EU-region retention settings (see Marcus' note below) and encrypt in transit (TLS + presigned S3 with server-side encryption) or upload to a shared Drive folder if you prefer.

Marcus / Monica: can you confirm the exact fields we will expose (schema) and the estimated compressed export size for a 7-day sample from our EU region? Also confirm turnaround time — auditor wants samples within 48–72 hours if possible.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Irene / Monica / Thomas — technical details below. I kept the export conservative to satisfy auditors while minimizing PII exposure.

What we log (admin activity) — canonical export fields we can include:
- event_time (ISO8601)
- actor_type (admin | system)
- actor_id_hash (salted SHA256; original attrs not included)
- actor_email_redacted (boolean)
- action (grant_role | revoke_role | update_policy | create_api_key | delete_api_key | change_setting)
- object_type (user | key | policy | project)
- object_id_hash (salted SHA256)
- target_tenant_hash (salted SHA256)
- ip_address (anonymized to /24 or omitted on request)
- geo_region (country code)
- request_method
- request_path
- response_status_code
- latency_ms
- request_payload_digest (SHA256 of payload - no payload content)
- correlation_id

Retention by region (current defaults, configurable per-customer):
- EU (gdpr-region): 365 days (admin activity index + compressed ledgers)
- US: 730 days
Notes: We can generate a short-term sample from cold storage for the requested 7-day window. Export size estimate: ~120MB compressed Parquet for a medium-sized account (7 days, ~5k events) — we'll provide an exact number after we run an export job.

Delivery options:
- Preferred: presigned S3 URL with SSE-S3, 24-hour expiry.
- Alternate: encrypted upload to a shared Drive folder (we post an encrypted zip with PGP).
- We can also produce a single-file Parquet plus CSV schema and a README (explaining hashing salt strategy).

PII handling:
- We never export raw password data or full request bodies.
- Emails and user names are hashed. If HelixCare needs reversible mapping for their internal audit, we can provide a mapping table to HelixCare's secure KMS-wrapped envelope (requires formal request and approvals).

Turnaround: If we spin an export job now and preserve samples, we can deliver within 48 hours (subject to approval for producing cross-tenant samples).

I'll attach a small schema CSV and a short export-playbook for ops to follow.

— Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Observability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: admin_activity_schema.csv, sample_export_parquet.snippet

Thomas — heading to the delivery steps. Attached is our internal playbook (admin_activity_export_playbook_v2.pdf) and a small README. Summary of next steps: 

1) Please confirm acceptance of salted SHA256 hashing for actor_id and tenant_id (we will include the salt name in the README but not the raw salt).
2) Confirm delivery method preference (presigned S3 link OR Drive). If S3, provide a bucket name (we will upload to a locked bucket you control via presigned put; link validity 24h). If Drive, we'll produce a PGP-encrypted zip.
3) Confirm date range: you requested Nov 1–7; we'll run the job against EU region logs and return estimated size.

Requested timeline: if you confirm options by EOD, we can schedule export and share artifacts within 48 hours. Please also acknowledge that exported artifacts will include hashed identifiers only and IP addresses will be truncated to /24.

Deliverables we will attach/link: admin_activity_schema.csv (field descriptions), sample-7day.eu.parquet (Parquet file), export_README.txt (hashing and salt description), custody_manifest.json (list of files + checksums).

Best,
Monica Patel
